Patuakhali was freed on this day in 1971
2013-12-08T00:10:57+06:00 | Star Country Desk
https://www.thedailystar.net/news/patuakhali-was-freed-on-this-day-in-1971

Patuakhali district was freed from the Pakistan occupation forces on this day in 1971.

Meanwhile, people of Magura, Gaibandha, Satkhira and Chuadanga yesterday celebrated the day of freedom from the enemy forces.

On December 8 in 1971, the heroic freedom fighters of Patuakhali freed the district from the clutches of Pakistani army, reports our correspondent.

The district unit of Muktijoddha Foundation has chalked out various programmes, including colourful rally, discussion meeting and cultural function, in the town on the occasion.

After the declaration of independence on March 26, several battles took place in the area and the occupation army aided by their local collaborators committed a number of massacres.

On April 26 in 1971, Pakistani army carried out looting, killing and torturing on women in the town. On the day, they gunned down seven Ansar members at the residence of the deputy commissioner as a committee was formed in the area on the Independence Day to resist the enemy forces.

The then DC Abdul Awal handed over rifles to freedom fighters from the store house of local police lines. Later, the Pakistani army killed the DC for helping the freedom fighters.

In the last week of November in 1971, freedom fighters entered Patuakhali town and defeated Pakistani troops in a few battles.

They finally declared the district free on December 8 and hoisted national flag atop the judge's court building.
